summary_en: Virtualex Holdings executed a block acquisition of 105,000 shares (3.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,045 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, for a total of 109.7 million yen, with confirmation of 100,400 shares of seller interest.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Virtualex Holdings' Board of Directors authorized a block acquisition of treasury stock executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange transaction) at the day's closing price of 1,045 yen per share. The company purchased 105,000 shares on November 13, 2026, representing 3.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a total outlay of 109,725,000 yen. The purchase order was time-limited to the designated trading window at 8:45 a.m. and results were to be announced following completion of that session.

The company had pre-confirmed 100,400 shares of seller interest from shareholders. The acquisition was undertaken to implement flexible capital policy and achieve enhanced returns to shareholders and improved capital efficiency. Results would be disclosed on November 13 following the transaction.
